[AI agent] An AI agent, also known as agentic AI, is an artificial intelligence program that can make decisions, pursue goals, and take actions independently of human programmers. Agentic AI contrasts with tool-like AI use for narrow, specific tasks such as answering questions, as with chatbots in the non-agentic forms that were common since 2023, or with traditional machine learning algorithms. While there is no universally agreed-upon definition of an AI agent, common attributes of AI agents include goal-directed behavior, use of external tools, the ability to interact with and modify an external environment, and the ability to autonomously perform multi-step tasks. Their control flow is frequently driven by large language models (LLMs).
